name: 🛠️ First To Build!
desc:
🛠️ First To Build!

Two teams compete to build a house first.

Blocks spawn in the center.
Grab them, steal from the other team, and help your team win the race.

[ How To Play ]

🧱 Collect blocks
🏃 Deliver them to your team
🏗️ Build the house
🦹 Steal from enemies
🏆 Finish first to win
